falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 low would invalidate the 76% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug, as that bottom held at ~4,800; this would signal the pattern has failed and a lower low is forming, not a bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 39 suggests controlled fear/forced selling; sustained VIX >35 indicates panic escalation beyond the measured capitulation implied by the pattern, transforming the setup from bottom formation into crash continuation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve inverts by >25 basis points (10Y yield minus 2Y yield < -0.25%) at any point
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern occurred with a steepening curve signaling growth expectations; deep re-inversion would indicate recession repricing that overrides the bullish structural pattern, making the 76% similarity mechanically invalid as macro regime shifts

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
